messages:
ben: Quick Q about rental cars for next weekI want to decline the insurer the rental company pushes and use our company coverage. Also, do we reimburse fuel if I return the car not full but used the prepay fuel option?
people-ops: Short answers: (1) Use company-approved providers or add the company insurance waiver if the booking flow supports it. (2) Prepaid fuel is allowed but usually not cost-efficient; finance prefers you return full and claim fuel charges.
people-ops: Details: if you booked through the corporate booking portal, collision/damage waiver (CDW) is covered under our corporate rental contract for approved vendors. If you booked personal or the vendor is not on the approved list, you need manager approval to decline vendor insurance and will need to provide a written risk acceptance.
ola: How do I know which vendors are approved?
travel-admin: Approved vendors are listed in the travel portal under "Car rentals" (Hertz, Avis, Enterprise in most regions). If you must use a non-listed vendor, capture the rental agreement and preapproval comment in your expense.
ben: About fuel  I used the prepaid fuel option at pickup because of time. Can I claim the difference?
people-ops: If you prepay fuel we accept reimbursement but expect you to choose the most economical option. Finance will compare the prepaid fuel line item to typical fuel price for that city/date. If prepaid is significantly higher you may be asked for manager justification. Receipts required: rental agreement showing prepaid fuel charge + card statement line.
people-ops: If you return not full and did not prepay, submit fuel receipts (gas station itemized receipts) for reimbursement. We do not accept screenshots of tank level as proof.
ben: What about tolls and parking?
people-ops: Tolls and business parking are reimbursable with receipts. If you used a toll pass billed to the rental company include the rental invoice showing toll charges. For automated tolls where you receive a surcharge from the rental company include both the raw toll invoice (if provided) and the rental company's billing showing the surcharge.
ola: Any rules for insurance excess/deductibles if I have an accident?
people-ops: If you have an incident, file an incident report with travel@redwood.example immediately and include police report if available. If the deductible is charged to you, finance can reimburse the deductible if the trip was business and the incident was not due to negligence. Manager sign-off required.
finance-bot: :receipt: Reminder: Attachments required for rental car expenses:
- itemized rental agreement (pdf)
- card statement line showing charge (screenshot)
- fuel receipts (if claiming actuals) or rental invoice showing prepaid fuel
- toll/parking receipts
- incident report + manager approval (if applicable)
travel-admin: Pro tip: if renting for multi-city trips, book under a single reservation and keep all return/pickup agreements in one file to avoid split-charge confusion.
ben: Thanks all  I'll try to rebook via the portal and avoid prepay fuel next time.
people-ops: Sweet. Ping us if the vendor forces insurance and the portal didn't cover it; we can approve on a case-by-case. :thumbsup:
